Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Sorrento hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 17 of the 18 Sorrento hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 6, the hotel's own site at 3, Hotels.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Booking.com at 1, Catchit.com at 1, Clicktrip.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. Taxes and fees at Sorrento hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Hotel Il Faro to 11% at Yacht Club Capo Cervo Suites Sorrento. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
